function.description:
TravelGym environment interaction tool. Use this tool in every interaction round. It supports three operations through the choice parameter: search queries the travel database for exactly one travel aspect; action communicates with the simulated user to elicit detailed preferences; answer submits exactly one recommended option ID. Supported search aspects and returned option fields are:

flight - Search flight options. Each flight option includes: path (array of airport/city names from origin to destination, including layovers); time (flight and layover durations in hours, alternating between flight and layover); company (airline names for each leg); flight_number (flight numbers corresponding to each airline leg); cost (total economy-class ticket price in USD); amenities (available in-flight amenities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Flight option IDs use the F prefix.

hotel - Search hotel options. Each hotel option includes: name (hotel name); room (available room types with capacity); cost (costs for different room types for the entire stay in USD); rating (hotel rating on a scale of 0-10); amenities (available facilities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Hotel option IDs use the H prefix.

restaurant - Search restaurant options. Each restaurant option includes: name (restaurant name); cuisine (type of cuisine); expectation (price level expectation); rating (average rating on a scale of 0-10); reviews (customer review counts by star rating); tags (descriptive features). Restaurant option IDs use the R prefix.

apartment - Search apartment rental options. Each apartment option includes: name (listing name or brand); room (bedroom/bathroom configuration); capacity (maximum number of guests); cost (total rental cost for the entire stay in USD); rating (rating on a scale of 0-10); amenities (available facilities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Apartment option IDs use the A prefix.

rental_car - Search rental-car options. Each rental-car option includes: brand (rental company name); model (specific car model); categories (vehicle category); seats (number of passenger seats); cost (total rental cost for the entire period in USD); insurance (available insurance options with costs); service (additional services with costs). Rental-car option IDs use the C prefix.

For search, put one clear, focused database query in content and cover only the relevant arguments for one aspect. For action, put the exact user-facing question or utterance in content. For answer, put only one option ID in content. Always include reasoning in thought.

function.description:
TravelGym environment interaction tool. Use this tool in every interaction round. It supports three operations through the choice parameter: search queries the travel database for exactly one travel aspect; action communicates with the simulated user to elicit detailed preferences; answer submits exactly one recommended option ID. Supported search aspects and returned option fields are:

flight - Search flight options. Each flight option includes: path (array of airport/city names from origin to destination, including layovers); time (flight and layover durations in hours, alternating between flight and layover); company (airline names for each leg); flight_number (flight numbers corresponding to each airline leg); cost (total economy-class ticket price in USD); amenities (available in-flight amenities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Flight option IDs use the F prefix.

hotel - Search hotel options. Each hotel option includes: name (hotel name); room (available room types with capacity); cost (costs for different room types for the entire stay in USD); rating (hotel rating on a scale of 0-10); amenities (available facilities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Hotel option IDs use the H prefix.

restaurant - Search restaurant options. Each restaurant option includes: name (restaurant name); cuisine (type of cuisine); expectation (price level expectation); rating (average rating on a scale of 0-10); reviews (customer review counts by star rating); tags (descriptive features). Restaurant option IDs use the R prefix.

apartment - Search apartment rental options. Each apartment option includes: name (listing name or brand); room (bedroom/bathroom configuration); capacity (maximum number of guests); cost (total rental cost for the entire stay in USD); rating (rating on a scale of 0-10); amenities (available facilities free of charge); service (additional services with costs). Apartment option IDs use the A prefix.

rental_car - Search rental-car options. Each rental-car option includes: brand (rental company name); model (specific car model); categories (vehicle category); seats (number of passenger seats); cost (total rental cost for the entire period in USD); insurance (available insurance options with costs); service (additional services with costs). Rental-car option IDs use the C prefix.

For search, put one clear, focused database query in content and cover only the relevant arguments for one aspect. For action, put the exact user-facing question or utterance in content. For answer, put only one option ID in content. Always include reasoning in thought.

choice.description: Operation to perform: search the travel database, action to communicate with the user, or answer to submit one option ID.

content.description: For search: one focused query for flight, hotel, restaurant, apartment, or rental_car. For action: the exact utterance to the user. For answer: exactly one F/H/R/A/C-prefixed option ID.
